detail: Open and closed clients followed their fallback policy while the runner gateway remained live.
With both containers down, existing open UDP and fresh traffic reached the WAN while closed traffic stayed blocked.
A running runner with xray unavailable withdrew its gateway and native fallback protected the LAN.
The existing runner continued serving the LAN while the control container was unavailable.
WAN observations from before the power cycle proved closed protection until the proxy recovered.
Native recovery restored proxying on the existing open UDP socket and DNS for fresh queries. The existing owner SSH connection survived.
